changes: Branch edit controls freeze only while their own submission is pending or unresolved. Captured persisted revision is handed off and clearDraftSnapshot clears only that exact revision; newer durable drafts survive success and receipt recovery.

Branch and review input controls and dismiss actions are protected during pending submission, including synchronous duplicate submission. Existing useWorkflow unmount fences and recovery behavior remain active.

Rename and project forms use existing useWorkflow receipt gates, freeze pending or unknown drafts, preserve definite-failure drafts, and guard close and duplicate submission. Rename remounts its form on thread identity changes.
Workspace mkdir, copy and remove fields freeze during pending or unresolved writes. Receipt recovery has a synchronous guard and retains the form when the receipt confirms not_sent.
Controls remain editable when no submission is in progress, including switching to separate review when inline review is unavailable.
